reply_text:
Found two issues in `receipt-lines` (`a6c40d4`) against `main`:

1. **High — Printed prices are 100× too large** — `receipt/render.py:2`  
   `format_money` formats cents directly as dollars. `format_money(1299)` returns `$1299.00` instead of `$12.99`; two coffees at 450 cents print `$900.00` instead of `$9.00`. Convert cents to dollars before formatting. Add literal expected-value assertions—the current test compares against the same faulty formatter, so it passes.

2. **Medium — The renderer doesn’t use the new right-alignment helper** — `receipt/render.py:7`  
   `render_line` still uses a fixed 20-character label field, leaving amounts left-aligned rather than right-aligned to the 32-column receipt width. Different-length prices end in different columns. Use `align` in the rendering path and test that rendered amounts end at column 32.

All three existing tests pass. No files changed. I’d fix the currency conversion before merging.
